acceptedScope: production/deterministic evidence coverage, commands and counts, negative validation, and matrix coverage
findings: The exact review subject and limitation hashes match; all twelve direct bindings, nine crosswalk evidence bindings, four reviewed public-document hashes, and the seven-file Story 4.14 manifest independently verify without drift.

The bound capture provides one passing 10.843-second multi-process PostgreSQL production-path case and 21 deterministic methods yielding 33 of 33 passing cases; focused production and support each have zero skips, while the 25 broad-lane skips are explicitly recorded as pre-existing and are not used as closure evidence.

The production matrix covers writers and failover, inclusive expiry and compaction, authority change, diagnostic leakage, and sanitized PostgreSQL end-state; it uses shipped Release entry assemblies with disclosed Testing-only hosting, deterministic-time, trusted-intent, and boundary-counter seams.

Recorded pre-review arithmetic recomputes exactly to 32 of 32 successful commands and 237 of 237 passing tests with zero failures or skips; fresh review reruns passed pre-review validation, 49 semantic mutations, authority and limitation mutations, consumer bootstrap, runtime-mode isolation, workflow guards, and Tenants skip and token guards.

Landed commit and tree identity are exact and ancestral; the 26 captured paths resolve, all 24 non-evolved capability paths show no landed-to-HEAD, worktree, or index drift, and the DaprTestContainerFixture override is exact from 0da109af79cb0ded1c9e7377c4140a561ef682f1cf23b7c0fbb6284b7401c216 to 28a89849a864014f4e18ab0bd791c4e905cc662799c8a58fce7e9627762dde9a.
Consumer bootstrap is exact and ordered through the local virtual environment and pinned PyYAML 6.0.3, and all nine external operational-authority exclusions remain false.
